title: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) Leaders Detained Amid Delhi Protests
summary: Delhi saw a second day of protests led by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Protests at Jantar Mantar and surrounding areas resulted in the detention of several leaders, with police enforcing strict security measures. The CJP accused the government of security violations, and leaders were released after being produced before a magistrate.

facts.statement: Several CJP leaders, including Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, and Saurav Das, were detained under preventive arrest following their flight at the Jantar Mantar protest.
Protests at Jantar Mantar and other locations in Delhi resulted in the detention of over 7,000 protesters and their leaders.
The CJP accused the government of security violations, and leaders were released after being produced before an executive magistrate.

sources.title: Delhi Police detains several protesters on second day of CJP protest
sources.description:
Several protesters were detained by security personnel while marching towards Jantar Mantar from Connaught Place's Inner Circle and Rajiv Chowk here, as the protest called by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) entered its second day on Sunday.
Visuals showed protesters marching towards Jantar Mantar and raising slogans of "Gyanesh Kumar isteefa do (resign Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar)".
Security personnel moved in to detain them, and several protesters, despite offering resistance, were seen being dragged and pulled towards police buses.
The area remained under an intense security arrangements to stop the protesters from going towards Jantar Mantar. The CJP had vowed to continue protests, announcing another demonstration at the protest site at 10 am on Sunday after the government thwarted their efforts on Saturday.
Several protesters who were detained on Sunday alleged that they were manhandled during the detentions.

sources.title: CJP leaders released by magistrate, told to maintain peace for one year
sources.description:
Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were under preventive arrest following their detention at the Delhi airport ahead of the Jantar Mantar protest, but were later released after being produced before the executive magistrate on Sunday.
They were released on condition that they would not "breach peace" for a year, CJP legal affairs head Ratna Singh said.
Earlier on Sunday morning, police said that the CJP leaders were put under preventive arrest after being detained by Delhi Police after their flight landed in the national capital and that they will be produced before the executive magistrate at Delhi Cantt Police Station.
Section 126 (security for keeping peace) and 170 (arrest to prevent commission of cognisable offences) of the BNSS were invoked against the CJP leaders, according to sources.

sources.title: CJP accuses police of kidnapping leaders, compares situation to Emergency
sources.description: More than 7,000 protesters, including opposition leaders and former chief ministers, were detained as Delhi Police clamped down on protesters demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation

sources.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released from police custody after detention
sources.description:
YouTuber Dhruv Rathee, who was detained by Delhi Police ahead of the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) protest at Jantar Mantar, was released late on Saturday night, an official said on Sunday.
"He can be detained again, or further legal action might be taken if he tries to go to Jantar Mantar despite prohibitory orders," a police source said.
Rathee was detained from his residence in Gurugram's Sector 56 on Saturday as police stepped up security across the national capital to prevent protesters from reaching Jantar Mantar for a demonstration demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities related to the SIR.
The detention came amid an unprecedented security clampdown in Delhi, where more than 7,000 protesters were detained at multiple locations, police sources said.

sources.title: Dipke, Ranka, Das under preventive arrest, to be produced before magistrate
sources.description:
Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das have been placed under preventive arrest and will be produced before the Executive Magistrate at Delhi Cantt Police Station on Sunday, a senior police officer said.
They were put under preventive arrest after being detained by Delhi Police after their flight landed in the national capital ahead of the planned protest at Jantar Mantar on Saturday, police said.
Police had made elaborate security arrangements and foiled protesters from reaching Jantar Mantar on Saturday.
